title: 第384章 坏蛋，可以亲我一下吗？
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【当前灵晶髓数量】：61089

挂鼎中的灵石又矮了一大截。

秦然的心在滴血。

他从挂鼎中取出升级后的狐祖手令，造型一如之前那般古朴陈旧，但其中蕴含的气韵却有了质的飞跃。

二女敏锐察觉到了异样。

秦然笑着递给香香，“拿去，一会儿在秘境中说不定用得上。”

香香有些激动地接过狐祖手令。

此物对狐族血脉有着难以抵御的诱惑力，香香的一缕神识探入其中，下一秒震惊地捂住了小嘴。

“这…这不是狐祖手令！”

小灵儿一脸疑惑，“香香姐姐，你犯什么傻，这当然是狐祖手令。”

香香震惊的看着秦然。

“为什么！”

小灵儿不解打断，“香香姐姐，你们到底在打什么哑谜！这不就是狐祖手令吗？上面那股气息，是九尾天狐的血脉气息没错！”

香香摇头。

忽然抬手按住了小灵儿的香肩。

后者下意识挣扎，但体内莫名被压制的那一大截灵力，让她的小脸瞬间色变。

“我的境界！”

“我的境界被压制了两大阶！！”

“从大圣境二重天，压制到了飞天境！！！”

香香咽了咽唾沫，俏脸上露出惊容。

“果然，我感知的没错！这不是传说中的狐祖手令，这比狐祖手令更强！”

秦然拉着二女的手，没多解释。

“你们不用多问，此物以后你们就带在身上留着防身，对你们的修炼也大有裨益。”

“一会儿进去后带着它，说不定会有意外惊喜！”

二女欣然点头。

秦然笑道：“进去吧，好好传承，出来后帮朕一起打理江山。”

香香扑进了秦然怀里，白嫩的俏脸，紧紧贴在他胸口上。

感受着蓬勃的心跳，她的小脸上多了几分心动和暖意。

“坏蛋～你答应本宫的，这次绝对不许再耍赖！”此事已成为了香香的执念，临行之前还不忘又提醒了一句。

秦然被逗笑了，“放心，到时你别求饶就行！”

小灵儿一脸都不开心。

“陛下～你都好久没陪人家睡觉了，人家也想和你一起睡觉觉～”

[Current number of spiritual crystal marrow]: 61089

The spiritual stone in the hanging cauldron has become a lot shorter.

Kieran's heart was bleeding.

He took out the upgraded Fox Ancestor Token from the hanging tripod. The shape was as simple and old as before, but the charm contained in it had made a qualitative leap.

The two women were keenly aware of the strangeness.

Qin Ran smiled and handed it to Xiangxiang, "Take it, you might need it in the secret realm later."

Xiangxiang took the Fox Ancestor's order with some excitement.

This object has an irresistible allure to the fox bloodline. Xiangxiang's ray of consciousness penetrated into it, and she covered her mouth in shock the next second.

"This...this is not the Fox Ancestor's warrant!"

Xiao Ling'er looked puzzled, "Sister Xiangxiang, why are you so stupid? This is of course the Fox Ancestor's warrant."

Xiangxiang looked at Qin Ran in shock.

"Why!"

Xiao Ling'er interrupted in confusion, "Sister Xiangxiang, what kind of riddle are you trying to solve! Isn't this the fox ancestor's order? The aura above it is the blood aura of the Nine-tailed Sky Fox!"

Xiangxiang shook her head.

Suddenly he raised his hand and pressed Xiao Ling'er's shoulder.

The latter struggled subconsciously, but the large amount of spiritual power that was inexplicably suppressed in her body caused her face to change color instantly.

"My realm!"

"My realm has been suppressed by two levels!!"

"From the second level of the Great Saint Realm, suppressed to the Feitian Realm!!!"

Xiangxiang swallowed, a look of shock appeared on her pretty face.

"Sure enough, what I sensed is correct! This is not the legendary Fox Ancestor's Order. This is stronger than the Fox Ancestor's Order!"

Qin Ran took the two girls' hands and didn't explain much.

"You don't need to ask any more questions. You can keep this thing with you from now on for self-defense. It will also be of great benefit to your cultivation."

"Take it with you when you go in later, maybe there will be an unexpected surprise!"

The two girls nodded happily.

Qin Ran smiled and said: "Go in, pass on the inheritance well, and help me take care of the country when you come out."

Xiangxiang threw herself into Qin Ran's arms, her fair and pretty face pressed tightly against his chest.

Feeling the vigorous heartbeat, her little face became a little more excited and warm.

"Bad guy~ You promised me that you will never cheat again this time!" This matter has become Xiangxiang's obsession, and she did not forget to remind her before leaving.

Qin Ran was amused, "Don't worry, just don't beg for mercy when the time comes!"

Xiao Ling'er looked unhappy.

"Your Majesty~ You haven't slept with me for a long time, and I want to sleep with you~"
